_comment: Loom ambient-capture — generic MCP-client / coding-agent variant.
Not every client uses Claude Code's settings.json schema, but most can
exec a command on lifecycle events. This file is a reference mapping:
wire each of your client's events to the matching command below.
The scripts are identical to the Claude Code build — they read the hook
payload as JSON on stdin and take the event name as the first argument.
If your client passes a different payload shape, the scripts accept the
common alternates: sessionId, transcriptPath, user_prompt, toolName/tool,
Replace ${LOOM_PLUGIN_DIR} with this directory's absolute path. Auth and

on_tool_failure.description: After a tool/MCP call errors — the bug-triage signal.

on_session_start.description: Session start. Prints a context primer to stdout (on by default; LOOM_INJECT_CONTEXT=false disables).

on_pre_compact.description: Before context window compaction — crystallize first.

on_session_end.description: Session end — crystallize the finished session.

on_user_prompt.description: Each user prompt. The first one of a session opens a loom run (run ledger); later ones are no-ops.

on_session_end_run.description: Session end — close the loom run opened by on_user_prompt (run.complete). Wire alongside on_session_end.

on_pre_compact_working_memory.description: Before compaction — write the session's working-memory note (goal, tree, edited files, last text) so the primer after the drop starts from it. Wire alongside on_pre_compact.

on_stop_working_memory.description: After each assistant turn — refresh the working-memory note when it changed.

on_pre_compact_session_brief.description: Before compaction — send the events since the last save to session.brief_save, which revises the branch's session brief. Wire alongside on_pre_compact.

on_session_end_session_brief.description: Session end — the same save for whatever happened after the last compaction. Wire alongside on_session_end.
